analysis: The trial executed successfully but achieved host macro validation HR@10 of 0.5188, below the supplied 32-to-8 mining parent (0.5700) by 0.0512 and the earlier recurrent result (0.5737) by 0.0549. Category HR@10 was Movies_and_TV 0.535, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.590, Electronics 0.385, and CDs_and_Vinyl 0.565. These results do not support the gated current-item residual under the retained training setup. Direct item features may have disrupted the recurrent representation or optimization, but the reported results cannot establish the cause. Parent category metrics and gate diagnostics were not supplied, so category-specific regressions and gate behavior cannot be determined.
code_summary: One independently trained GRURec checkpoint per category, with four-category routing. The network uses 96-dimensional tied item embeddings, input LayerNorm, dropout, a two-layer GRU, projection and LayerNorm, normalized similarity scoring, learned item bias, and learned score scale. The experimental change adds a jointly trained feature-wise sigmoid gate over concatenated recurrent and undropped current-item features, then adds the gated item features to the GRU output before projection. Gate weights initialize to zero and biases to -2. Training retains 32-to-8 hard-negative mining, softplus loss, AdamW, seed 42, and validation checkpoint selection. The generated predictor instantiates the same architecture and strictly loads exactly one checkpoint per category; checkpoint-reload and predictor-parity checks are included.
